title: Autonomous computational search for methane bisulfate-radical hydrogen transfer
difficulty_reasons: The Agent must formulate and discriminate plausible elementary mechanisms and transition structures, justify search coverage, and validate the selected conclusion without an author-route hint.

paper.title: Reactivity, selectivity, and mechanism of Bi(V) promoted methane C-H functionalization in concentrated sulfuric acid

data.description: Closed molecular identities, charge, multiplicity, solvent boundary, temperature, and elementary-step scope.

required_deliverables.description: Independent hypotheses, validated candidate structures, barrier when available, evidence, uncertainty, and conclusion.
